tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List all digital marketing services offered by LeadCore Digital (Google Ads, SEO, Facebook Ads, web design, lead generation, etc.) with each service's slug, title, and short description.

tools.name: get_service
tools.title: Get service details
tools.description: Get details for a single LeadCore Digital service by its slug (e.g. 'google-ads-management', 'seo', 'facebook-ads-management').

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List client projects
tools.description: List LeadCore Digital's client project case studies with title, category, market, description, tags, and key performance metrics (conversions, impressions, CPC, spend).

tools.name: get_agency_info
tools.title: Get agency info
tools.description: Get LeadCore Digital's core agency information: name, tagline, contact channels (phone, WhatsApp, email), location, and the list of industries served.
